items.title: Pradeep Rai elected new Supreme Court Bar Association president
items.summary: Senior Advocate Pradeep Rai was on Tuesday elected as the new president of the Supreme Court Bar Association (SCBA). He defeated nearest rival Senior Advocate Anupam Lal Das by 371 votes. The final tally of votes is as follows: Aadish Agarwalla - 412 Gaurav Bhatia - 370 Anupam Lal Das - 451 Pradeep Rai - 822 Sukumar - 269 Mahalakshmi Pavani -128 Siddharth Mridul - 217 Former High Court Chief Justice among 6 candidates for SCBA President Senior Advocate Rahul Kaushik has been elected as the Vice President of SCBA, while Pragya Baghel has been elected as the Secretary of SCBA.
